70: 	@Override
71: 	public void handle(final AnnotationValues<ExtensionMethod> annotation, final JCAnnotation source, final JavacNode annotationNode) {
72: 		handleExperimentalFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.EXTENSION_METHOD_FLAG_USAGE, "@ExtensionMethod");
73: 		
74: 		deleteAnnotationIfNeccessary(annotationNode, ExtensionMethod.class);
75: 		JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.up();
76: 		boolean isClassOrEnumOrInterface = isClassOrEnumOrInterface(typeNode);
77: 		
78: 		if (!isClassOrEnumOrInterface) {
79: 			annotationNode.addError("@ExtensionMethod can only be used on a class or an enum or an interface");
80: 			return;
81: 		}
82: 		
83: 		boolean suppressBaseMethods = annotation.getInstance().suppressBaseMethods();
84: 		
85: 		List<Object> extensionProviders = annotation.getActualExpressions("value");
86: 		if (extensionProviders.isEmpty()) {
87: 			annotationNode.addError(String.format("@%s has no effect since no extension types were specified.", ExtensionMethod.class.getName()));
88: 			return;
89: 		}
90: 		final List<Extension> extensions = getExtensions(annotationNode, extensionProviders);
91: 		if (extensions.isEmpty()) return;
92: 		
93: 		new ExtensionMethodReplaceVisitor(annotationNode, extensions, suppressBaseMethods).replace();
94: 		
95: 		annotationNode.rebuild();
96: 	}

99: 	public List<Extension> getExtensions(final JavacNode typeNode, final List<Object> extensionProviders) {
100: 		List<Extension> extensions = new ArrayList<Extension>();
101: 		for (Object extensionProvider : extensionProviders) {
102: 			if (!(extensionProvider instanceof JCFieldAccess)) continue;
103: 			JCFieldAccess provider = (JCFieldAccess) extensionProvider;
104: 			if (!("class".equals(provider.name.toString()))) continue;
105: 			Type providerType = CLASS.resolveMember(typeNode, provider.selected);
106: 			if (providerType == null) continue;
107: 			if ((providerType.tsym.flags() & (INTERFACE | ANNOTATION)) != 0) continue;

110: 		}
111: 		return extensions;
112: 	}

117: 		if (tsym != null) for (Symbol member : tsym.getEnclosedElements()) {

120: 			if ((method.flags() & (STATIC | PUBLIC)) == 0) continue;

142: 		public ExtensionMethodReplaceVisitor(JavacNode annotationNode, List<Extension> extensions, boolean suppressBaseMethods) {

144: 			this.extensions = extensions;
145: 			this.suppressBaseMethods = suppressBaseMethods;
146: 		}

148: 		public void replace() {

150: 		}

157: 		}

159: 		private void handleMethodCall(final JCMethodInvocation methodCall) {
160: 			JavacNode methodCallNode = annotationNode.getAst().get(methodCall);
161: 			
162: 			if (methodCallNode == null) {
163: 				// This should mean the node does not exist in the source at all. This is the case for generated nodes, such as implicit super() calls.
164: 				return;
165: 			}
166: 			
167: 			JavacNode surroundingType = upToTypeNode(methodCallNode);
168: 			
169: 			TypeSymbol surroundingTypeSymbol = ((JCClassDecl)surroundingType.get()).sym;
170: 			JCExpression receiver = receiverOf(methodCall);
171: 			String methodName = methodNameOf(methodCall);
172: 			
173: 			if ("this".equals(receiver.toString()) || "this".equals(methodName) || "super".equals(methodName)) return;
174: 			Map<JCTree, JCTree> resolution = new JavacResolution(methodCallNode.getContext()).resolveMethodMember(methodCallNode);
175: 			
176: 			JCTree resolvedMethodCall = resolution.get(methodCall);
177: 			if (resolvedMethodCall == null || resolvedMethodCall.type == null) return;
178: 			if (!suppressBaseMethods && !(resolvedMethodCall.type instanceof ErrorType)) return;
179: 			
180: 			JCTree resolvedReceiver = resolution.get(receiver);
181: 			if (resolvedReceiver == null || resolvedReceiver.type == null) return;
182: 			Type receiverType = resolvedReceiver.type;
183: 			
184: 			// Skip static method access
185: 			Symbol sym = null;
186: 			if (resolvedReceiver instanceof JCIdent) {
187: 				sym = ((JCIdent) resolvedReceiver).sym;
188: 			} else if (resolvedReceiver instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
189: 				sym = ((JCFieldAccess) resolvedReceiver).sym;
190: 			}
191: 			if (sym instanceof ClassSymbol) return;
192: 			
193: 			Types types = Types.instance(annotationNode.getContext());
194: 			for (Extension extension : extensions) {
195: 				TypeSymbol extensionProvider = extension.extensionProvider;
196: 				if (surroundingTypeSymbol == extensionProvider) continue;
197: 				for (MethodSymbol extensionMethod : extension.extensionMethods) {
198: 					if (!methodName.equals(extensionMethod.name.toString())) continue;
199: 					Type extensionMethodType = extensionMethod.type;
200: 					if (!MethodType.class.isInstance(extensionMethodType) && !ForAll.class.isInstance(extensionMethodType)) continue;
201: 					Type firstArgType = types.erasure(extensionMethodType.asMethodType().argtypes.get(0));
202: 					if (!types.isAssignable(receiverType, firstArgType)) continue;
203: 					methodCall.args = methodCall.args.prepend(receiver);
204: 					methodCall.meth = chainDotsString(annotationNode, extensionProvider.toString() + "." + methodName);
205: 					recursiveSetGeneratedBy(methodCall.meth, methodCallNode);
206: 					return;
207: 				}
208: 			}
209: 		}

211: 		private String methodNameOf(final JCMethodInvocation methodCall) {
212: 			if (methodCall.meth instanceof JCIdent) {
213: 				return ((JCIdent) methodCall.meth).name.toString();
214: 			} else {
215: 				return ((JCFieldAccess) methodCall.meth).name.toString();
216: 			}
217: 		}
218: 		
219: 		private JCExpression receiverOf(final JCMethodInvocation methodCall) {
220: 			if (methodCall.meth instanceof JCIdent) {
221: 				return annotationNode.getTreeMaker().Ident(annotationNode.toName("this"));
222: 			} else {
223: 				return ((JCFieldAccess) methodCall.meth).selected;
224: 			}
225: 		}

part.text:
Fixed and verified. 

**Root cause:** In `getExtension` (src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleExtensionMethod.java:120), the flag check `(method.flags() & (STATIC | PUBLIC)) == 0` only skipped methods that were *neither* static *nor* public. So when e.g. `java.lang.String.class` is listed in `@ExtensionMethod`, String's public instance methods (like `startsWith`) were collected as "extension methods", causing unrelated calls like `"foo".startsWith("f")` to be rewritten into a bogus static call `java.lang.String.startsWith("foo", "f")` → `incompatible types: String cannot be converted to int`.

**Fix:** Check the flags independently (upstream PR #3312), so non-static or non-public methods are ignored:

```java
if ((method.flags() & STATIC) == 0) continue;
if ((method.flags() & PUBLIC) == 0) continue;
```

**Validation:**
- Pre-fix, the issue's reproducer fails with the exact reported error; post-fix it compiles cleanly with the built `dist/lombok.jar`.
- `ant test.instance` (delombok transform tests): 382 tests, 0 failures — including the previously failing `ExtensionMethodNonStatic` and all other `ExtensionMethod*` cases.
